workspace: Beam workspace 2, authenticated with BEAM_TOKEN_2 from the repo .env (never BEAM_TOKEN)
python_packages_source: requirements-research.lock: all 167 exact pins (git sponsor lines excluded), installed with uv in the image
sponsor_archives_source: dependency-sources.lock.json (CircuitKIT, AuditKIT); SHA-256 verified at image build, installed with the lock as constraints

hourly_usd_source.RTX4090: Beam workspace 2 on-demand listing, reported by the operator 2026-11-10 (not re-scraped)
hourly_usd_source.A10G: UNVERIFIED placeholder upper rate; replace with the Beam listed serverless price

verification: image build fails unless every locked pin is installed at its exact version (see scripts/beam_entry.py verification_command)

pricing.source: https://www.beam.cloud/pricing and https://www.beam.cloud/serverless-gpu, read 2026-11-10 via web search excerpt (not a live console read)
pricing.gpu_per_hour_note: Public serverless GPU rates. The operator-reported console figure for RTX4090 is 0.66; the higher public rate is used so the guard is conservative.
pricing.cpu_ram_note: Per-vCPU and per-GiB rates derived from the public worked example (4 vCPU $0.76, 16 GiB $0.32 per hour). Serverless CPU and RAM are billed on top of the GPU rate.
pricing.A10G: UNVERIFIED: not listed among Beam serverless GPUs on the public pricing page (RTX 4090 and RTX 5090 only); the operator said A10G is available. Placeholder GPU rate 1.10 kept for the budget allowlist.
